rationale: For a study tool, we avoid standard 'SaaS Blue' or sterile enterprise looks. By combining soft pastel colors (Lavender, Mint, Yellow) with high-contrast Neo-Brutalist elements (thick black borders, hard drop shadows, bold typography), we create a highly engaging, tactile, and 'anti-boring' productivity dashboard. This aesthetic is distinct, modern, and perfectly suited for Gen Z students.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing within structured grids. Use the 'Control Room' grid for the Study Library and Progress trackers.

surface_strategies.cards: bg-white border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#09090B] rounded-md transition-all
surface_strategies.buttons_primary: bg-[#B1A9FF] text-black font-bold border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#09090B] rounded-md transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_#09090B] active:translate-y-[4px] active:translate-x-[4px] active:shadow-none
surface_strategies.buttons_secondary: bg-[#FDFBF7] text-black font-bold border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#09090B] rounded-md transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 active:translate-y-[4px] active:translate-x-[4px] active:shadow-none
surface_strategies.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-md p-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#B1A9FF]

components_instructions.navigation: Sticky top nav with solid white background, 2px black bottom border. Logo in Black text. Links in Outfit font. Mobile nav should use a thick bordered dropdown.
components_instructions.document_uploader: Large drag-and-drop zone. Pastel Yellow (#FDE047) background on hover, thick dashed 2px black border. Centered prominent Phosphor folder icon.
components_instructions.status_badges: Processing: Yellow bg (#FDE047), Black border. Ready: Mint bg (#A7F3D0), Black border. Failed: Red bg (#FF6B6B), Black border. Font should be small, uppercase, bold.
components_instructions.quiz_interface: One-by-one MCQ style. Answer options as thick-bordered white cards. Selected state: Mint bg (#A7F3D0) with translate effect (active state). Add a prominent progress bar with thick black borders.
components_instructions.charts: Recharts or Shadcn charts. Use primary and secondary colors (Lavender and Mint) for bars/lines. Grid lines should be distinct and black, axes in Outfit font.
components_instructions.tables: Admin panel tables must have borders around EVERY cell (border-collapse). Header row bg: Lavender (#B1A9FF) with bold text.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Elements should lift up slightly and cast a larger solid shadow.
motion_and_interactions.click: Neo-brutalist 'press' effect: translate x and y positively (e.g., active:translate-y-[4px] active:translate-x-[4px]), remove drop shadow to simulate physical button press.

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or Bold weight. They match the chunky neo-brutalist aesthetic perfectly. Avoid thin/light icons.

hero_background.description: Abstract pastel geometric 3D background for the landing page or auth screens.

dashboard_empty_state.description: Stylish notebooks and pens, use as an illustration when the study library is empty.

student_avatar.description: Default avatar or testimonial image of a student studying.

auth_split_image.description: Young man studying with a laptop. Perfect for the left/right split section of Login/Register screens.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Pitch Black text on pastel backgrounds easily passes.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-document-button', data-testid='quiz-option-a').
